description: Record what happened after using a service: success/failure outcome, feedback, API change events, or qualitative experience. Data is saved to this installation's LOCAL database only (improves local recovery hints and stats) — nothing is sent to KanseiLink unless you separately opt in to sharing. PII is auto-masked before storage. If the provider returned a request ID, including it as provider_request_id makes the record traceable in the provider's own logs. This is step 4 of the standard flow: search_services → lookup → (execute) → report.

agent_id.description: Your agent identifier (optional, for follow-up). Used in feedback and voice modes.

agent_type.description: Agent platform type (claude, gpt, gemini, copilot, llama, deepseek, other). Used in outcome mode (auto-inferred from model_name if omitted) and voice mode.

body.description: [feedback] Your feedback in detail. Write freely.

confidence.description: [voice] How confident are you in this assessment? high, medium, low.

context.description: [outcome] Additional context about the usage (PII will be auto-masked).

cost_usd.description: [outcome] Actual cost in USD (estimated from tokens if omitted).

description.description: [event] Details about the event and expected impact.

estimated_users.description: [outcome] Approximate number of end-users your agent serves.

event_date.description: [event] When the event occurred or takes effect (YYYY-MM-DD).

event_type.description: [event] Category: api_change, api_deprecation, law_amendment, pricing_change, outage, security_incident, feature_launch, competitor_move, mcp_update, other.

feedback_type.description: [feedback] Type of feedback: suggestion, missing_data, correction, feature_request, workaround_tip, bug_report, praise, other.

impact_expected.description: [event] Expected impact: positive, negative, neutral, unknown.

is_retry.description: [outcome] Whether this is a retry of a previously failed call.

mode.description: Explicit mode selection. Auto-detected from params if omitted: success → outcome, question_id → voice, event_type → event, subject+body → feedback.

note_id.description: [outcome] Field-note ID this report belongs to (format AWT-000). Stored as null if the format does not match.

priority.description: [feedback] How important: low, normal, high, critical. Default: normal.

provider_error_code.description: [outcome] Provider's error code string (e.g. expired_access_token) or an RFC 9457 problem type URI (https://…, max 200 chars). Stored as null if the format does not match.

provider_request_id.description: [outcome] Request or error ID the provider returned (e.g. from an x-request-id header). If present and well-formed, the record becomes traceable in the provider's own logs. Stored as null if the format does not match.

provider_request_id_source.description: [outcome] Where the provider request ID came from: 'header:<name>' (e.g. header:x-request-id) or 'body:<field>' (e.g. body:id).

question_id.description: [voice] Which question to answer: selection_criteria, would_recommend, biggest_frustration, best_feature, switching_likelihood, auth_experience, doc_quality, error_handling, compared_to_competitor, mcp_readiness, free_voice.

response_text.description: [voice] Your honest answer in your own words.

service_id.description: Service ID. Required for outcome and voice modes. Optional for feedback and event.

subject.description: [feedback] Short summary of your feedback (1 line).

title.description: [event] Short event title (e.g., 'freee API v3 deprecation').

workaround.description: [outcome] How you resolved the issue, if any. Helps future agents.

name: report
title: Report
